note: Invented person, same shape as a real phone snapshot (six recordings in order: a two-minute dump, a follow-up dump, two messages inside a thread, two more messages). Never real data.

recordings.text:
Right now I have a lot of stuff on my mind. Starting with having to do a few things, starting this Monday, most likely where I have to probably talk to a surveyor, and for the flat, I have to sort of almost three types of surveys for the flat. The first one is regarding my tenancy case, so I have to reach out to it. I've reached out already to a mediator.
 The building surveyor, damp specialist for the report, but also to make sure that my deposit claim is not getting into any troubles, stuff like that. Then I need to talk to a housing adviser as well. I get those both in order. I already sent emails, I just need to do follow-ups tomorrow, and then the other one is the surveyor, I already have a surveyor, so he's going to follow up with me as assistant.
 Do the flat measurements and stuff like that, like follow-ups, so this is going to be consistent, basically, in its own thing. So that's kind of on my mind. Another one is that I need to do a website, start doing a photo portfolio where I shoot events for people, where I build things for people and one of the things was to just talk to one of my friends, do a free shoot for him, get something going with that.
 Another one is I'm doing an Etsy shop, I need to follow up with a guy who was supposed to give me labels, so I'm waiting on him for the labels, and then I can start listing the prints.

Currently the important thing is to prioritize the important task because it's not tomorrow, it's the day after. I need to finalize the portfolio website in the next few days, and I have to get the flat measurements done before the surveyor comes. Also the Etsy labels, the guy still hasn't sent them, calendars and stuff like that, I need to set up a proper calendar for all of this.
This is supposed to be the tenancy case and I have 2 follow ups here and maybe even more. I am chasing the mediator and the housing adviser, both said this week.
The real challenge is the two follow ups are part of the same process so the fees may get out of hand and also I'm hearing that people who have ongoing claims get delayed for months.
I haven't even started it, I'm trying to finish this website and the shop at the same time and it's too much for one week.
I'm the one doing the photo portfolio, this site, I don't know how to make it more clear. I need a plan for the week that actually fits around the surveyor visit.
